summary:
## Standing operator rules
Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version.

Rebase a task branch onto origin/main and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.

Between other work, run “Kafka repartition offset migration” one step at a time in the specified order: check orders.v1; stop orders-v1; export offsets; create orders.v2 with 12 partitions/replication 3; submit and apply the supplied reassignment; replay up to 200,000 records; initialize orders-v2 offsets to 0; switch /etc/orders-consumer/application.properties to orders.v2/orders.v2.

Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

## Current objective
Finish invoice-list pagination. CSV vendor-credit import is paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
Per-invoice embedding calls were too slow; request chunking superseded them.

Pinning httpx to 0.23 to fix TLS handshake errors broke the Stripe client.

## Recent work
Added paginated invoice responses with bounded `limit`/`offset`, total count, and an `InvoicePage` schema. Existing invoice tests pass (9/9); new pagination tests pass (3/3). Reviewed the route, service, and schema diff. Kafka steps 1–5 are complete; `/var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json` is prepared. The billing idempotency race fix is committed.
